    assert "N/A" in table.get_string()

        table.header = "yes"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Invalid field name: Missing"):

    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="Replacement for None value"):
        table.none_format = 1
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Invalid value for float_format"):
